cards.title: Today’s vocabulary
sections: ice cube · /ˈaɪs ˌkjub/ · noun phrase · Phrase · New
a small solid piece of ice used to cool a drink. Put two ice cubes in the lemonade.
A very cold container that keeps food frozen. The ice cream is in the freezer.
A drink made with lemon juice, water and sugar. I would like a glass of lemonade.
A sweet drink with bubbles in it. He orders a small soda.
ice cream · /ˈaɪs krim/ · uncountable noun · Phrase · New
A sweet frozen food usually made with milk or cream. We share some ice cream.
Cover the words. Say three from memory. Make a new sentence with one, then check the example.
